intent.summary: Sanitized tracked state as an opt-in product capability (clone-resume for private collaborative repos) with self-repo opt-out and schema v4 cleanup dropping the dead version field and re-anchoring project_root without machine paths; a tracked-flip transaction gate enforcing language check plus census plus gitignore reconciliation at the ignored-to-tracked boundary; codebase knowledge files (structure/conventions/concerns/untested-fns) travel with clones through the gate; stage-back gap exhaust de-duplicated into state.gaps as the single source with concerns.md cured of 88 auto mirrors. Issues #11 file-availability half, #24 re-triage

requirements.text: Sanitized tracked state as an opt-in product capability (clone-resume for private collaborative repos) with self-repo...

decisions.title: A-1 identity de-pathed: v4 drops version+project_root; repo_id=origin-URL hash; root runtime-derived
decisions.rationale: version: zero readers. project_root conflates identity with location; tracked-state ruling changed its premise. repo_id keeps guard, kills paths. No-remote: advisory.

decisions.title: D-G dialogue governance to an independent small phase before P2, not absorbed into P4
decisions.rationale: Session relapse (B card lost table, no standing deepen option) proves parked concerns have no teeth. P4 keeps content-policy scope; new small phase ships contract upgrade + thin-gate extension early.

decisions.title: B obligations attach to tracked files: no repo-mode flag; self-repo opt-out = negative assertion
decisions.rationale: census + cjk-whitelist are the complete file-attached signal surface. Knowledge files are agent-crafted: flip preset covers UX; mode flag only serves a circular forgot-warning. #20 precedent.

decisions.title: C flip gate = gos track command + gos gate reconcile leg, census-if-present, no hook layer
decisions.rationale: Executor: atomic surgery (backup+rollback). Detection: shipped gate leg. Census leg runs only when census.json exists. Hook layer deferred until a rogue flip costs more than a gate round-trip.

decisions.title: D-1 cure: migrate 88 auto mirrors to local gap-history ledger, then cure concerns.md
decisions.rationale: User final ruling (revised from delete): mirrors move to .gos/logs/gap-history.ndjson (untracked); concerns.md returns to curated-only. If no consumer in 6 months, downgrade to delete.

decisions.title: D-2 language boundary at the state write path (single point), tracked-conditional
decisions.rationale: One check covers all text fields. Fires only when state.json is git-tracked (obligations attach to files, D-14). Fail-closed with bilingual guidance; cache git status in-process.

decisions.title: E repo_id = normalized-URL hash matched against all remotes; no-remote = advisory null
decisions.rationale: https/ssh heterogeneity makes origin-exact a false-positive machine eroding guard credibility. sha256(canonical)[:16] keeps tokens out. Six-form test matrix; anchor fix re-derives on misses.

decisions.title: P4 BUILD additions: self-repo knowledge refresh + THINK navigator hint (blast/closure discoverability at design time)
decisions.rationale: Drift is live poison (4800-line claims injected every task). THINK lacks BUILD's D-65 blast wiring; design-time impact awareness closes the navigator gap. User ruling: both in P4.

decisions.title: F navigator tiers: guide trio flips w/ stamp; map data tracked; byproduct regenerates w/ provenance header
decisions.rationale: codebase/ = AI dependency navigator (user ruling). Tiers: data (map trio, gate inputs, tracked); guide (hand-written trio, flips w/ born-at stamp); byproduct (unmapped-fns, regen, header).
